title: Profiling In Vitro Intratumor Heterogeneity Using Single-Cell Sequencing
author: Smit, Feller, et al.

steps.title: Incubate cells with first dye
steps.instruction: Add the first photoactivatable dye to the culture medium, incubate the cells, and illuminate the first region of interest (ROI) with near‑UV light to phototag cells in that ROI.

steps.title: Wash and incubate with second dye
steps.instruction: After the first illumination, wash the cells, add the second photoactivatable dye, incubate, and illuminate the second ROI; because both dyes are present during the second illumination, cells in the second ROI become double‑labeled, allowing three distinct populations (unlabeled, single‑labeled, double‑labeled).

steps.title: Harvest cells for FACS
steps.instruction: Detach and collect cells while keeping them on ice, preparing a single‑cell suspension suitable for fluorescence‑activated cell sorting.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate culture medium and wash cells with 2 mL DPBS.
Add 250 µL Trypsin‑EDTA (no phenol red) to the glass area of the dish and incubate 20–30 min at 37 °C until cells detach.
Using low‑retention pipette tips and tubes, gently pipette up and down to dissociate cells and transfer the suspension to a 1.5 mL tube.
Rinse the dish with 200 µL Trypsin‑EDTA (no phenol red) and add the rinse to the same tube.
Rinse the dish again with 200 µL HBSS containing Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺ (pH 7.0) and add to the tube.
Gently pipette the combined suspension to further dissociate cells.
Centrifuge 4 min at 4000 × g (pellet may be small; mark tube exterior to locate pellet).
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 400 µL HBSS; keep the suspension on ice.

steps.title: Optional viability staining
steps.instruction: Assess the effect of photolabeling on cell viability using Draq7 before sorting.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the ice‑cold cell suspension in 620 µL HBSS.
Add 3.1 µL of 0.3 mM Draq7 viability dye.
Mix gently and incubate 5 min at 37 °C protected from light.
Proceed to FACS; live cells will be Draq7‑negative.

steps.title: FACS sort photolabeled cells
steps.instruction: Sort live, single cells into 384‑well plates pre‑loaded with CEL‑seq2 primers, spike‑ins, and dNTPs, then prepare plates for storage.

substeps.instruction: Sort cells according to the instrument’s user manual, gating for live (Draq7‑negative), single cells, and then separating the three populations: unlabeled (center), PA‑JF646‑only (outer ring), and PA‑JF549 + PA‑JF646 (middle ring).
Collect each cell into a well of a 384‑well plate containing the required reagents.
Centrifuge each plate briefly, remove the aluminum cover, and reseal with fresh aluminum foil.
Centrifuge plates 1 min at 1000 × g to settle cells at the bottom of wells.
Immediately place plates on dry ice and store at –80 °C (up to 3 months) until shipment for sequencing.
